note: The original describes it as forma matangensioides of Eutermes matangensis, with the alate, soldier and worker all present. The original is in German, taken from the OCR of a library scan at the Internet Archive; one head width figure is misprinted in the original and is explained in the text.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: (The original has it as forma matangensioides n. f. of Eutermes matangensis.) Very consistent with E. matangensis but slightly smaller, the posterior margin of the pronotum less deeply concave. Body length with wings 15—16 mm; body length without wings 9 mm; fore wing length 13 mm; head length 1.79 mm; head width 1.63—1.67 mm (printed in the original as 1,63—1,07, the second figure presumably a misprint for 1.67); pronotum width 1.33—1.37 mm, length 0.77 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Colour and pilosity as in the typical form (matangensis), the body slightly smaller. Body length 4—4.5 mm; head including nasus 1.9—1.98 mm; head length (without nasus) 1.03 mm; head width 1.33 mm; pronotum width 0.68 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: As in the typical form. Body length 5—6 mm; head width 1.44 mm; pronotum width 0.91 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Distribution: Sarawak, Borneo (Haviland); Krakatau (Jacobson). Holmgren notes that this form is Haviland's matangensis form no. 359. In the key it is distinguished from matangensiformis by the very weakly concave pronotum, the head width of 1.33 mm and the larger compound eyes.
